annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅转发文化和旅游部等部门《关于促进房车消费的若干措施》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council Forwarding the Several Measures on Promoting Recreational Vehicle (RV) Consumption by the Ministry of Culture and Tourism and Other Departments
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office notice forwarding ministerial measures to promote recreational vehicle (RV) consumption: better product quality and standards, relaxed scrappage rules, road and parking access, campground land use, rental, finance and insurance support, and safety management. Not about AI or robotics beyond a passing mention of AI in rental services.
key_provisions_or_claims: Develop safety and component standards for RVs and revise motor vehicle type standard
Relax RV scrappage limits (no mandatory scrappage for small private RVs; rentals 15 to 25 years)
Ensure RV road access, parking and campground land supply
Support RV rental, finance and insurance products
Strengthen safety responsibility; ban campgrounds in disaster-prone or ecologically sensitive areas
